thought.text: All dev processes stopped. Now do a clean search index rebuild without the worker racing:

reasoning_content: The processes have stopped. I'll check the port and perform a clean rebuild of the search index.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$PATH"
cd /workspaces/workspace
export MEMCACHE_SERVERS=memcached:11211
export DATABASE_URL=postgres://zammad:zammad@postgresql:5432
export REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
export ES_URL=http://elasticsearch:9200
export ES_INDEX=estest.local_zammad
bundle exec rails zammad:searchindex:rebuild > /tmp/searchindex3.log 2>&1
echo "SEARCHINDEX3_DONE_EXIT=$?" >> /tmp/searchindex3.log
tail -3 /tmp/searchindex3.log
'
